description: This file manages sandbox pruning operations, including cleaning up sandbox containers and browsers based on activity and age thresholds. It imports various registry and backend management modules, and defines functions for determining prune eligibility, executing pruning, and orchestrating the process with error handling.

methods.name: shouldPruneSandboxEntry
methods.description: Determines if a sandbox registry entry should be pruned based on idle time and age thresholds.

methods.name: pruneSandboxRegistryEntries
methods.description: Generic function to prune sandbox registry entries, removing runtime and registry entries, with optional callback on removal.

methods.name: pruneSandboxContainers
methods.description: Prunes sandbox container registry entries based on configuration.

methods.name: pruneSandboxBrowsers
methods.description: Prunes sandbox browser registry entries, including stopping browser bridge servers if necessary.

methods.name: maybePruneSandboxes
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that triggers sandbox pruning with rate limiting and error handling.
